# Supplemental license sources

These packages omit top-level license files in their published archives. Original texts were obtained from the sources below or their installed README/source notices. Preserve these supplements when regenerating the inventory. Upstream master references describe the supplemental notices retrieved at publication time, not a claim that THE Note uses upstream master source.

- https://github.com/dropbox/rust-alloc-no-stdlib/blob/0a81fd6928ea3b33c8cd484aa4575d50ffb98012/LICENSE
- https://github.com/madsmtm/objc2/blob/b4167b582b2f75f9a1be75495c41b765344fd03c/LICENSE.md
- https://github.com/knurling-rs/defmt/blob/4a8cdb44891ed57b8ff5a023b6bec7137c48708f/LICENSE-APACHE
- https://github.com/knurling-rs/defmt/blob/4a8cdb44891ed57b8ff5a023b6bec7137c48708f/LICENSE-MIT
- https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/blob/447fa9f3f993fe77724189e355078b38ce20baea/LICENSE-APACHE-2.0
- https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/blob/447fa9f3f993fe77724189e355078b38ce20baea/LICENSE-MIT
- https://github.com/terrastruct/d2/blob/master/LICENSE.txt
- https://github.com/terrastruct/d2/blob/master/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt
- fastdom: unmodified License section from the installed 1.0.12 README.md.
- strictdom: unmodified License section from the installed 1.0.1 README.md.
- pathfinder_geometry / pathfinder_simd: copyright and dual-license notice copied verbatim from each installed crate’s src/lib.rs. The included standard Apache-2.0 text is the selected license option.
- selectors: standard MPL-2.0 text; the installed crate declares MPL-2.0 in Cargo metadata and its source headers.
